new_results.statement: For any regular fibre of one affine-linear and one quadratic equation, int_M prod f_i * j_ij <= 2 for every normalized physical coordinate-pair Jacobian j_ij; hence int_M prod f_i * prod j_ij^{p_ij} <=2 for every probability weights p_ij.

If m fixed coordinate-pair Pluecker components capture the normal pencil with minimum singular value eta, the curved section mass is <=2 m^(3/2)/eta and the single-hub density is <=1/2+8 sqrt(2)m^(3/4)eta^(-1/2)|lambda|^(-1/2).
